ITEM 1 | Whole glossy red ovoid piece with smooth skin and tiny dark seed specks, about 4 x 3.5 cm and 3 cm tall, sitting at the left edge of the plate | 25
ITEM 2 | Halved red piece with a pale, slightly fibrous core and glossy red outer flesh, cut face up, about 4.5 x 3.5 cm, on the upper center-left | 30
ITEM 3 | Red conical piece with a pointed tip and tiny dark seed specks, about 3 x 3 cm, at the top center | 15
ITEM 4 | Red wedge with a moist, glossy cut face and a few seeds, about 3.5 x 3 cm, at the upper right beside a dark berry | 15
ITEM 5 | Dark purple-black knobby cluster of small drupelets with a matte, bumpy surface, about 2.5 cm across, at the right edge | 8
ITEM 6 | Small blue-black round berry with a smooth, slightly dusty sheen, about 2 cm diameter, at the top center | 4
ITEM 7 | Tiny dark purple round berry with a smooth surface, about 1.2 cm diameter, just left of the top-center berry | 1.5
ITEM 8 | Small dark blue round berry with a smooth surface, about 1.2 cm diameter, at the lower center near the red wedge | 1.5
ITEM 9 | Large red wedge with a glossy, moist surface and a visible pale center line, about 4 x 3 cm, at the center | 25
ITEM 10 | Red wedge with a slightly matte cut face and small seed specks, about 4 x 3 cm, at the center-left below item 2 | 25
ITEM 11 | Pinkish-red crumbly cluster of small drupelet-like pieces with a dry, grainy texture, about 3 x 2.5 cm, at the lower left | 10
ITEM 12 | Triangular red slice with a glossy, moist cut face and visible seed specks, about 4.5 cm long, at the bottom center | 25
ITEM 13 | Small half-round red piece with a glossy skin and smooth cut face, about 3 cm across, at the lower right | 12
ITEM 14 | Half-moon red piece with a glossy, moist cut surface and a small pale spot, about 4 cm across, at the right | 20
ITEM 15 | Small reddish juice spot with a thin, watery film on the plate surface, about 1 cm across, at the lower center | 2
